data.name: Anushah
data.gender_notes: Anushah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Nun-Shin-Ha', meaning 'answer' or 'response'. In Islamic context, it symbolizes seeking and receiving guidance from Allah. The name Anushah carries the meaning “Answer, response” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Anushah usually hope their child will grow to embody answer, response and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Seeking and receiving guidance from Allah.
data.etymology: Anushah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Answer, response.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anushah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
